explanation: This method is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because percent-formatting embeds item[0], trname[1], and trname[2] directly inside double quotes in the SQLite INSERT query. Crafted translation strings containing quotes could escape the literals and execute arbitrary SQL commands. The repair switches to '?' placeholders and passes t = (item[0], trname[1], trname[2], ) as a bound tuple to self.cursor.execute().
